title: ACME Insurance KPI dataset
description: Schema sidecar for the curated KPI CSV (Gold layer). One row per (year, period, channel, product_line). Declares the 'kind' of each metric so the Phase 8 executor can refuse nonsensical aggregations (e.g. sum(renewal_rate)) without the LLM ever being asked.

year.description: Reuses settings.kb_covered_years. Year 2023 is intentionally absent - executor raises OperationViolation(reason="year_gap") for queries that target it.

period.description: FY = annual total. Q1-Q4 and M01-M12 are mutually-exclusive grains: FY = sum of Q1..Q4, each Q = sum of its 3 months (for flow metrics; for rates/snapshots the relationship is weighted).

policies_in_force.description: End-of-period stock. Do NOT sum across periods within the same channel/product (each row is already the running total). Across channels/products within a period, sums are valid.

new_policies.description: Period flow. Sum freely across periods and dimensions.

renewal_rate.description: Percentage of eligible policies that renewed during the period. Sum is meaningless; aggregate with weighted_mean using policies_in_force as the weight.

gross_written_premium.description: Period flow. Quarterly bumps in Q4 are expected (annual policy renewals).

claims_reported.description: Number of new claims reported during the period.

claims_paid.description: Number of claims settled and paid in the period. Lags claims_reported by ~5 days on average.

avg_claim_settlement_days.description: Average number of days to settle a claim, computed over claims paid in the period. Aggregate across periods with weighted_mean using claims_paid as the weight.

nps.description: Net Promoter Score snapshot at end of period. Aggregate with mean (or weighted_mean by policies_in_force across channels).

operating_expenses.description: Period flow. Includes salaries, IT, marketing - everything except claims paid.

digital_adoption_pct.description: Percentage of new_policies sold or claims filed via the digital channel. Aggregate with weighted_mean using new_policies as the weight.

comment: The executor reads `valid_aggregations[metric.kind]` and rejects any aggregation not in the list. This is the one place where domain rules live - the planner LLM never sees this list, it sees only the metric names and dimension domains via the prompt.
